status_effects.explanation: Being visibly rebuffed by her husband and forced to retreat marks a small local loss of standing in the scene.
He is recast from a once-impressive society figure into a minor, largely forgotten provincial acquaintance.
The narrator's comparison casts her account of her ties to Bréauté as self-serving exaggeration.

appraisal_events.evidence: en voyant sa femme venir lui parler, il prit un air si furieux qu'elle ne put que se retirer
appraisal_events.explanation: The duke visibly rebuffs the duchess when she approaches him, forcing her to withdraw in front of the narrator, a small public marital snub.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Si vous voulez des détails sur Bréauté, qui n'en valait guère la peine »; « dépouillé de son esprit, relégué dans ses années si lointaines... il avait lui aussi sa marque provinciale »
appraisal_events.explanation: The duchess dismisses Bréauté as hardly worth discussing, and the narrator confirms he has faded from a once-glamorous figure into a forgotten provincial neighbor.

appraisal_events.evidence: Moins mensongèrement que Gilberte quand elle disait de Bréauté : « C'est un vieux voisin de campagne, j'ai plaisir à parler avec lui de Tansonville », alors qu'autrefois... il ne les fréquentait pas
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator singles out Gilberte's claim of past closeness with Bréauté as more dishonest than his own potential self-presentation, a mild rebuke of her self-serving exaggeration.
